subject: Who signs when? Discovery recap + approvals
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murray <alex.murray@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: decision-makers and contract sequencing

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick written recap so we’re all aligned and can hand off to legal/procurement smoothly. Please confirm/edit the bullets below if anything is off.

Call highlights
- Primary use case: embedding search + summarization for clinician notes (no PHI in test dataset).
- Decision criteria: latency under 300ms p95 for short queries, cost per 1M tokens target <$200, audit/logging for every request.
- Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, org sign-off by end of Q3.

Stakeholder map (as discussed) — please confirm names/roles:
- Economic buyer: Maria Gonzales, CFO (final sign-off on spend).
- Procurement / PO: Samir Khatri (procurement intake, vendor forms, PO).
- Legal operations: legal.ops@orionhealth.com (contract sequencing + redlines).
- Security reviewer: security@orionhealth.com (questionnaire + architecture review).

Suggested contract routing (proposed by Redwood)
1) NDA (mutual) — quick sign via DocuSign to enable sharing of internal artifacts and security questionnaire. Expected turnaround: 48 hours once both parties engage.
2) Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — concurrent with DPA review; expected internal security review 3–5 business days.
3) DPA negotiation — target 7–10 business days for first pass; smaller redlines only.
4) MSA / commercial terms — final redline round, target 2–3 weeks depending on number of open issues.

Owners from Redwood
- Sofia Ivanova (you + me for discovery / DocuSign + templates)
- Ben Carter (contracts & pricing escalation)
- Karthik Iyer (security liaison for questionnaire / architecture)

Attachments: MAP_Draft_Orion.pdf (application/pdf), Orion_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Next steps (ask for Alex):
- Confirm stakeholder list and procurement/legal contacts (Samir + legal.ops)
- Confirm whether you prefer Redwood or Orion to start the DPA draft
- Please confirm preferred SLA for NDA turnaround (default 48 hours ok?)

Thanks — I’ll queue up the DocuSign NDA template and the mutual action plan once you confirm contacts.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Murray <alex.murray@orionhealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal.ops@orionhealth.com, Maria.Gonzales <maria.gonzales@orionhealth.com>, Samir.Khatri <samir.khatri@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision-makers and contract sequencing

Sofia — thanks for the thorough recap. All looks good, a few clarifications: 

- Confirmed stakeholders: Maria (CFO) is the economic approver; Samir (procurement) will field vendor forms and PO. Legal Ops (cc’d) owns contract sequencing. Security review will be with our architecture/security team (I looped them in below).
- On DPA: we typically prefer the vendor to share their standard DPA first so our team can place comments. Can Redwood share your DPA?
- NDA timeline: 48 hours turnaround is reasonable from our side once it lands in DocuSign.

Couple of asks for the security review:
- Our team will need a simple data flow diagram and a list of controls (encryption in transit/at rest, k8s hosting, where logs persist).
- Please confirm whether Redwood will require SSO integration for production pilot and the default data retention policy for logs and embeddings.

I’ll let Legal Ops coordinate the exact intake steps. Samir — our procurement will need vendor contact info and your standard invoices/pricing sheet for PO.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Murray
Head of Product — Data Platform
Orion Health
alex.murray@orionhealth.com

On Wed, Jul 21, 2026 at 5:05 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Murray <alex.murray@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision-makers and contract sequencing

Alex / team — appreciate the quick confirm. A few internal notes on sequencing and recommended handoffs so expectations are clear from our side: 

1) NDA: Sofia will initiate DocuSign (mutual). We use a short mutual NDA; if Orion prefers to use your NDA, that’s fine — either way we’ll aim for 48-hour turnaround once signatures are in flight.
2) Security questionnaire: Karthik will own the technical responses and coordinate with Orion security for any artifact exchange. Expect a 3–5 business day window for our first pass after we receive the completed questionnaire.
3) DPA: we typically share Redwood’s standard DPA as a starting point — cuts down negotiation time. Sofia, can you attach our DPA template when you send the NDA?
4) MSA/commercial: Ben will drive pricing redlines and any commercial concessions — please raise specific clause asks (indemnity/limitation/term) so we can triage.

Turn-time SLOs (internal target)
- NDA: 48 hours after DocuSign is sent
- Security questionnaire: 3–5 business days for Redwood’s responses
- DPA: initial vendor template + first redline back in 7–10 business days
- MSA: 2–3 weeks depending on number of negotiated clauses

I’ll prepare the DPA + a one-page intake for procurement (vendor contact + sample invoice) and send to Samir once Alex confirms procurement intake method.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision-makers and contract sequencing — next steps and owners

Team / Alex — quick management note to lock cadence and owners so nothing stalls: 

Action items
- Sofia: send Redwood NDA via DocuSign today and include the MAP_Draft_Orion.pdf as context. (Due: 2026-07-23 EOD)
- Ben: send Redwood DPA template and procurement intake one-pager to Samir (cc Alex) with standard invoice examples. (Due: 2026-07-24 noon PT)
- Karthik: begin preparing responses for Orion_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and schedule a 30-minute sync with Orion security for early next week. (Due: first pass by 2026-07-29)
- Alex / Legal Ops: confirm whether Orion prefers Redwood’s DPA or Orion’s to start negotiations — if Orion prefers your DPA, please share it to legal.ops email.

Internal escalation plan
- If DPA negotiations extend beyond 3 rounds or exceed 15 business days, escalate to my attention for prioritization.
- If security review raises architecture blockers, Karthik to flag for an executive sync with Orion security and Redwood engineering.

SLO reminders (agreed)
- NDA: 48 hours turnaround once DocuSign live
- Security questionnaire first pass: 3–5 business days
- DPA first pass: 7–10 business days
- MSA finalization: up to 3 weeks depending on redlines
